exact: positive regulation of plasma membrane long-chain fatty acid transport

definition: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of plasma membrane long-chain fatty acid transport. Plasma membrane long-chain fatty acid transport is the directed movement of long-chain fatty acids across the plasma membrane. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.
label: positive regulation of long-chain fatty acid import across plasma membrane
